title: Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales (September 2026 data) — the first combined business-inventories print on the restated wholesale basis, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, all 179 rows parsed), row "Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales | November 17, 2026 | 10:00 AM | September 2026", release code A202611171000, reference A202609. Corroborated by census.gov/mtis/index.html the same day, verbatim: "Revisions to the wholesale estimates are anticipated to be reflected in the September 2026 MTIS release scheduled for November 17, 2026." Further corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-11-17 row reads "Retail sales + inventories, Import and export prices, Industrial production". Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the mwts-benchmark-revision-2026-10-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). The rule this lane proposes MTIS editions by, stated so the selection is not arbitrary: track the MTIS releases Census itself NAMES as carrying an AIES restatement, and no others. Census names two — 2026-10-15 for the retail restatement and this one for the wholesale restatement — and both are proposed in this PR. This is the edition where the proposing event's output first reaches the combined business-inventories series that GDP's inventory line is built from, three weeks after the standalone revision and on a posted GDPNow vintage (the revision day itself, 2026-10-26, carries no vintage at all). The trap worth naming in advance is the same one the wholesale-trade-2026-12-09 ledger recorded for 12-16: a tracked entry already occupies 2026-11-17, and it is a different release — retail-sales-2026-11-17 is the 08:30 Advance Monthly Retail Trade report for OCTOBER data (A202611170830), while this is the 10:00 MTIS for SEPTEMBER data (A202611171000). Different hour, different reference month, different report. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling Census entries: no house playbook is macro-keyed (grep re-run 2026-09-06, 0 hits) and no instrument attaches. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
